name: KromiumBrowser
description: Main interface for the Kromium browser instance. Structured into multiple dedicated facades for separation of concerns: navigation, view, search, devTools, jsBridge, clipboard, downloads, automation, storage, proxyManager, security, and assets.
whenToUse: Obtain via client.createBrowser() to render, control, and interact with a Chromium web view instance.

properties.name: navigation
properties.description: Facade for URL loading, lifecycle waiting (DOMContentLoaded, NetworkIdle), and history traversal.

properties.name: view
properties.description: Facade for zoom control, audio muting, viewport resizing, and rendering visibility.

properties.name: search
properties.description: Facade for finding text on page, highlighting matches, and navigating find results.

properties.name: devTools
properties.description: Facade for opening and closing the native Chromium Developer Tools window.

properties.name: jsBridge
properties.description: Facade for bidirectional JavaScript interoperability, script execution, and native object binding.

properties.name: clipboard
properties.description: Facade for clipboard operations (cut, copy, paste, select all, undo, redo).

properties.name: downloads
properties.description: Facade for managing and controlling file downloads.

properties.name: automation
properties.description: Facade for headless automation, mouse/keyboard simulation, DOM querying, and PDF export.

properties.name: storage
properties.description: Facade for cache management, local storage inspection, and cookie clearing.

properties.name: proxyManager
properties.description: Facade for runtime dynamic proxy reconfiguration.

properties.name: security
properties.description: Facade for host locking, subresource restrictions, and iframe security.

properties.name: assets
properties.description: Facade for dynamic network asset filtering and content blocking.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes this browser instance and cleans up underlying resources.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumBrowser
import org.daviante.kromium.api.core.KromiumClient
import org.daviante.kromium.api.ui.KromiumUiFramework

fun setupBrowser(client: KromiumClient): KromiumBrowser {
    val browser = client.createBrowser("https://github.com", KromiumUiFramework.COMPOSE)
    browser.navigation.loadUrl("https://google.com")
    return browser
}
